newsitems.title: ExileCon 2026 Path of Exile 2 Race Qualifier Events
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: At ExileCon this November, we will be hosting competitive Path of Exile events live on the main stage. Both events will be the culmination of a series of four qualifier events where the best racers will compete for a spot in the finale. For Path of Exile 1 qualifiers, we’ll announce the details later. For Path of Exile 2, in each qualifier event, players will compete to be the first to defeat Tavakai in Act Four in a Solo Self-Found Runes of Aldur fixed layout environment. While this is not a Hardcore Event, players will incur a penalty upon death where they will not be able to move until a two and a half minute period has lapsed. The qualifier events are PC only. In order to join, click the "Join" button for the race in the Character Select screen. You'll then be prompted to create a character. Once you've spawned in, you won't be able to move your character until the race starts. Path of Exile 2 Qualifier Event Times and Dates Qualifier One - August 6 2PM PDT Qualifier Two - August 13 2PM PDT Qualifier Three - August 20 2PM PDT Qualifier Four - August 27 2PM PDT We suggest that you join the races early, as each race will start at the same time for all players. Prizes The first player to kill Tavakai in each event will receive the following: Flights to Auckland, New Zealand for the weekend of ExileCon Accommodation in Auckland for the weekend of ExileCon Entrance into the ExileCon Path of Exile 2 Race Finale An Ultra VIP ExileCon ticket A Demigod's Virtue Unique Helmet {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/d0b42b7d47c44b822da24dcd08df1b8fc6ab29e5.jpg Rules to Qualify: These races are free to participate in and anyone is welcome to join. You must connect your Path of Exile account to Twitch and stream your participation (on the linked account) for the whole event. If we can't watch any portion of your streamed entry, you are not eligible to win. If you win one of the qualifier events, you are not eligible to win another. If for some reason one of the event winners is not able to come to New Zealand, their ExileCon tickets, accommodation and flights will transfer to the person who achieves the next fastest time in any event. They will still receive their Demigod's Virtue but the other prizes will be transferred to the next eligible person. You must abide by Path of Exile's Terms of Service and Twitch's Terms of Service Unsportsmanlike conduct at any time in the leadup to ExileCon may result in you being disqualified from the event. Past and present Grinding Gear Games employees are not eligible to win prizes in these events. Where to Watch Each of these events will be hosted live on twitch.tv/pathofexile with shoutcasting by ZiggyD and RaizQT. Co-streaming is welcome! We look forward to seeing the results! Good luck to everyone who is planning to participate.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients Two Week Recap
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: The first two weeks of Return of the Ancients have come and gone, leaving behind a trail of triumphs and hard-fought battles. Together with Lily, our Data Analyst, we've unearthed a collection of highlights that capture the scale of the journey so far. Check out this snapshot of sacrifices made, legends forged, and the most-used skills: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/746fda48bbd1ea71af058f476451ac589aea33b2.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/9270bae4db3a5e059cd43317d38d144cda15a0b4.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/c4fea4a4d68ac0c834cf9bc4007ec8e0c62d4d9f.jpg The Return of the Ancients has left a staggering toll across Wraeclast. Players opened 219,088,375 Waystones and completed 6,187,370 Unique Maps. Over 8 Trillion Gold was collected. 262,915,249 Tablets were used when activating Waystones, with 59,115,949 of them being Abyss Tablets. 1,633,511 Maps were overrun by the Abyss, and 1,290,936 Corrupted Nexuses were cleansed. Yet every triumph came at a cost. Across the Standard leagues, 170,236,613 Exiles were slain, while 178,753 brave souls met their end in Hardcore. The most-played Ascendancies were the Martial Artist, Spirit Walker, and Deadeye, leading the charge against the darkness. As for the Arbiter of Divinity, the celestial being was struck down 1,249,367 times, proving that even divine power can be challenged. newsitems.title: What We Are Working On
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: The opening weekend of Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients is finished, so it's time to take stock and talk about what we are working on, and what still needs to be improved. The main issues that we were focusing on over the weekend were a significant number of progression blocking bugs in endgame quests. If you run into these, it effectively ends your progress, so they are rated as incredibly critical. Almost all the progression blockers we know about have now been fixed, but sometimes it's not incredibly clear in the hotfix notes, so if you did get stuck, we would encourage you to try again. In some cases the fixes might require you to rerun some content. We are also working through the list of the most common crashes that players experience. We have made a pretty good headway here already, but there are still more fixes to make. In addition to these simple bug fixes though, there are a few other things we are looking to address over the next week. General Endgame We are adding a large number of new atlas tree nodes which add more content to specific biomes. Once we add them, the points for these nodes will be added to existing maps, so you will get them automatically if you have already completed those maps. There is currently a bug where you can't independently map from two different hideouts while in a party. The atlas will remember where it was opened to if you reopen it in the same area. Some players experience a black screen during quest events that open the atlas. We are investigating the cause of this. Ritual When doing the Rite of the Nameless you can currently change your mind about which maps you picked. This allows you to potentially see more mods than if you didn't do that. This isn't as bad as it first appears because all the mods that you can see are prerolled, and it only selects in that set, but technically it's advantageous to do this. We will be changing the system to effectively lock in each choice. It's currently possible to get 100% ritual reroll cost reduction. This mechanic is still limited by the number of rerolls you can do per area, but it's possible through various mechanics to legitimately increase this to fairly high values. We will be capping this stat to 90% for safety. We are turning off the knockback on the Blood Waves ritual mechanic. The Mysterious Rites node needs a buff to its rewards. Delirium Currently it's possible to fail a Delirium by moving forward too quickly, especially if the fog is paused by doing another league mechanic. We will make this no longer possible. Breach Breach hive colony monsters are getting stuck and not pathing sometimes. This often results in the combat of these encounters being very underwhelming. The Tear Open The Rift notable will be made multi choice and have another bonus added as it's not always good for all players. As an additional gift we’re offering a few new cosmetic effects you can earn if you play in the Runes of Aldur during this Free Weekend. To clarify, all new and existing Path of Exile 2 players on all available platforms will be able to receive these microtransactions. newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: With Return of the Ancients launching on May 29th PDT, you may be wondering what will happen to the current Fate of the Vaal leagues and your existing characters. The Fate of the Vaal leagues will end on May 25th PDT. All characters and their items will then be migrated to the Standard or Hardcore Early Access leagues. There will be no wipes, so once the migration is complete, you’ll be able to continue playing your characters in the Standard or Hardcore Early Access leagues. Atziri’s Temple is staying in Path of Exile 2 as a core mechanic. We will cover the changes in more detail in the full 0.5.0 patch notes on May 21st PDT, but here are the main things you need to know: You will first find Vaal beacons in Act Three. Activating six of them (by finishing encounters) will unlock the Temple in the present. Complete more beacon encounters in “Doryani’s Contingency” Interlude to be able to visit the Temple in the past. Once you reach the Endgame, you can encounter Vaal Beacons in maps. The level of the Temple will be based on the area level where the crystals were collected, so in order to open high-tier Temples, you will need to run high-tier maps. There is a new region on the Atlas with guaranteed Vaal Beacon encounters in every map. Completing this area will give you points for the Temple Atlas Tree with many new bonuses for the Temple itself. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/c28f86814d81190a4fa8d6eca10cb9ed66a72b2f.jpg There are also new Temple Precursor Tablets that will guarantee Vaal Beacons in your map if you want to focus on this league. In order to prevent the “snake” strategy, rooms that are meant to be destabilised but cannot be removed without disconnecting parts of the Temple will instead be downgraded to paths. This applies to any form of destabilisation - using devices in selected Tier 3 rooms, opening the Vault, or general destabilisation on closing the Temple. Rooms can now be up to Tier 4 after unlocking this ability on the Temple Atlas Tree. This allows more specialisation into particular room types and encourages more interesting temple layouts. Reward Rooms granted from the console after defeating the Architect have been significantly improved, with more varieties to unlock in addition to upgrading the rewards of all the existing ones. Vaal Infusers were a single currency item that used to work on any armour and weapons. We have changed these into 4 distinct currency items that work on Armours, Martial Weapons, Caster Weapons and Jewellery, allowing you to use them with Catalysts as well. Any existing Vaal Infusers will become Vaal Armourer's Infusers and only apply to armour. All players will automatically get a maximum crystal cap of 60 and medallion cap of 6 so you no longer need to upgrade these yourself. Medallion drop rates have been improved at smaller Temple sizes, and slightly reduced at larger Temple sizes. Your existing Temples will be migrated to Standard Early Access leagues, however you will not be able to open your Te...

newsitems.contents: Last week, we announced the Return of the Ancients, our next major Content Update for Path of Exile 2. In this news post, we’re answering the most frequently asked questions from our community regarding the upcoming update. When does the Return of the Ancients launch on all platforms? Return of the Ancients will launch at 1PM May 29 PDT on all supported platforms, including the standalone PC client, Steam and Epic Games Store clients as well as Xbox Series and PlayStation 5. Will there be an economy reset? Your existing characters will still be available and playable in the Standard Early Access leagues. However, the new Runes of Aldur league starts with a fresh economy, along with new content and features, so it’s strongly recommended to play there. If you choose to continue with an older character, keep in mind that balance changes may affect your build. You might need to respec your passive points, and some mechanics or interactions may no longer work the same way as before. How do I start playing in a new league? When creating a character, select the Runes of Aldur banner. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/8c680ee13abe05b3b00b2557ed3a54d861d7bf01.png Is there a special in-game mechanic that is available only in the Runes of Aldur league and not in the core game? Once the league ends, we’ll evaluate these features and decide which ones, if any, will be added to the core game. Are there challenges in the Runes of Aldur league? Yes. In the Runes of Aldur League we’re introducing challenges to Path of Exile 2. By completing 8 challenges in the league, you will be able to earn pieces of an exclusive Knight of Aldur Armour Set. Do I need to create a new character and start the game from the beginning? Yes, if you want to play the Runes of Aldur League. However, you can continue playing your existing characters in the Early Access league if you wish. With Atlas being massively changed, what will happen to my Atlas progress in the Standard Early Access League? How do I start the new endgame questlines? In the Standard League, your existing Atlas, its progress, and Atlas Passive Tree will be reset, and you will start exploring the new endgame and all new storylines from the beginning. With Wraeclast laying in ruin after the devastating cataclysm, an ancient fortress has risen from the earth. Enter the fortress, discover its secrets, and its rewards. newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 0.4.0d Patch Notes Preview
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: Patch 0.4.0d for Path of Exile 2 is coming this week! Boss buff hover popups now show buff names, Temple Room placement has clearer upgrade information, as well as many other bugfixes and improvements. 0.4.0d Patch Notes Fate of the Vaal League Changes and Improvements Players who die during the Architect or Atziri boss fights in Atziri's Temple can now respawn in a new instance of the Temple with most other content removed, similar to how endgame maps work. Improved the Holten league mechanic placement variance and re-enabled Energized Crystals. Atziri's Chambers now correctly connects to any room placed next to it. The Temple now requires a minimum of 1 room placed each run before opening. This is to ensure players don't accidentally open the Temple before placing rooms and better guide new players in their first Temple. You can bypass this restriction by holding Ctrl while clicking on the Run Temple button. Gamepad users will instead get a confirmation prompt that they must agree to. Added user feedback on the Temple Map for if a room is completed or unreachable. Updated the Temple Mods list to match that of the in-map Mods List whilst running a temple. Updated the information on rooms when hovered in the Temple Map to show possible upgrades. Added description text to Atziri's Chambers to clarify how to unlock the room. Updated the Temple Destabilisation keyword to clarify random vs room completion destabilisation. Fixed a bug where some monsters inside the Vaal Temple were not receiving the intended amount of Monster Effectiveness Fixed a bug where transcendent limbs could be kept after dying. Fixed a bug where non-Temple owners could see dropped Temple Medallions, despite being unable to interact with them. Fixed a bug where Unique reliquary displays found in the Temple could not be opened while playing in couch co-op. Fixed the maximum medallion check for couch co-op, preventing players from picking up medallions if the Temple owner has the maximum amount. General Changes The character sheet now displays how much item armour, evasion and/or energy shield you have. Skills which reserve spirit now display their final, modified spirit reservation on the skill information popout. Added buff names to the buff hover information on enemies. Passive Skill Tree Notable Anointment displays no longer require the player to first pickup a Distilled Emotion. These can be viewed by holding ALT when hovering a notable passive on any character. Adjusted the damage of the following bosses found inside of the Trial of Chaos: Overall lowered the damage dealt by Bahlak, The Sky Seer Overall increased the damage dealt by Uxmal, the Beastlord All Quadrilla monster variants have been working out and now deal more damage. Reduced the damage of the 'Vornas, the Fell Flame' and 'Morvak, the Infernal' bosses. The Devour Skill is now able to consume your Minions when available. newsitems.title: Improvements to the Fate of the Vaal League
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: It’s been around one week since the launch of the Fate of the Vaal league, and a lot of our focus has been around fixing technical problems with the launch including crashes and bugs. However, after looking at feedback, we also have a lot of improvements to make to the league, so it’s time to talk about them! A consistent bit of feedback we have received is that rewards for the temple are not high enough, particularly in the endgame. The rewards simply don’t scale enough to make temples worth doing currently. In order to address that, we are making a bunch of changes, the first of which is buffing the mods that rooms add to the temple. We are approximately doubling the values on existing modifiers applied to the temple at all room tiers. The Spymaster, Golem Works and Thaumaturge rooms apply bonuses to other specific room types in the temple. The Corruption Chamber room at Tier III now also adds a Corrupted Abomination to the Temple. The Spymaster room at Tier III now also adds an Unchained Beast to Temple. The Golem Works room at Tier III now also adds a Royal Sentinel to the Temple. The Generator room at Tier III now also adds a Royal Colossus to the Temple. The Sacrificial Chamber room at Tier III now also adds a High Priest to the Temple. The Thaumaturge room at Tier III now also adds a Quadrilla Sergeant to the Temple. The Alchemy Lab room at Tier III now also increases Gold Found. The Treasure Vault room now also adds 25% Rarity of Items dropped to the Temple. We also had some crafting benches for Exalting, Vaaling and Alchemy that didn’t allow you to take their craft as currency. We didn’t want you to be able to take these as currency until after the events at the end of Act 3, but this never got implemented. But now: After Act 3, Exalt, Vaal and Alchemy crafting benches will allow you to take their currency. We still want the temple to scale even harder in the endgame though, so we wanted to make another change: Added a Medallion which will add random Waystone Modifiers to your temple that last for 10 Temple runs, allowing you to make it more difficult and rewarding. Be careful though, you can get some dangerous modifiers! We also wanted to make it a bit easier to get the specific rooms you need to get a certain combo. Added a Medallion that allows you to reroll rooms waiting to be placed. Another concern that players had was that defeating the Architect was resulting in too much progress lost, and the rewards were not worth it. To improve that we are making the following changes: Halving the number of rooms that are removed when defeating the Architect. Allowing Reward rooms placed from the Architect’s Console to connect to any other adjacent room, not just paths, making them easier to claim. newsitems.title: Introducing The Last of the Druids Mystery Box
newsitems.author: kiki
newsitems.contents: We recently released The Last of the Druids Mystery Box without duplicate microtransactions! Many of these microtransactions have a varying number of thematic variations that fits your style. Please note that currently The Last of the Druids Mystery Box is available only in Path of Exile 2. There are over than 60 microtransactions (including variations) that you can find in The Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Many of these microtransactions have a varying number of thematic variations, and you'll never receive a duplicate copy of a variation that you have already opened. For example, if you open one variant of a microtransaction, you may later receive another variant, but you'll never get a duplicate! Because of the lack of duplicates, each box you open implicitly increases the chance of opening the remaining microtransactions you haven't received yet. Check out the full details at pathofexile2.com/mysterybox

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2: The Last of the Druids Launches Soon
newsitems.author: kiki
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2: The Last of the Druids will launch on PC and consoles soon! In this news post, we’ve gathered all the information you need to know about what happens on launch day and how to start downloading early. Free Weekend December 12 11AM - December 15 11AM PST To celebrate the launch of Path of Exile 2: The Last of the Druids, we're making the game free to play for three days on all available platforms. As an additional gift we’re offering a few new cosmetic effects you can earn if you play in the Fate of the Vaal League during this Free Weekend. To clarify, all new and existing Path of Exile 2 players on all available platforms will be able to receive these microtransactions. Find out more about the Free Weekend here. Private Leagues Are Now Available Those of you who are planning to play in a Private Fate of the Vaal League at launch are now able to create them. Click here to set up your Private League (don’t forget to double check your start time upon creating)! Please note you cannot start these leagues until The Last of the Druids officially launches on December 12th (PST). The Last of the Druids Launch Information The realms will go down at December 12th 09:00 AM PST and patching will begin shortly after. newsitems.title: The Druid Comes to Path of Exile 2

newsitems.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/292e85eb0209709632c7b49de2b90479be7d2bab.png Path of Exile 2: The Last of the Druids is coming on December 12! Unleash the wild within as you shapeshift into wolf, bear, or even a fire-breathing wyvern! Explore brand new Ascendancy Classes, an innovative league mechanic where you can craft your own dungeon, and a new Pinnacle endgame boss! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/7c155fcd07b04578e8c54a36617765153423aeea.png The Druid is a shape changing elemental spellcaster. Using the sacred Talismans, a new type of weapon, the Druid can call upon the power of Draiocht to transform into an animal. In his human form, the Druid wields magical staves to channel the powers of the earth and the natural world. Raise scorching volcanoes from the ground, conjure roots to ensnare enemies, or strike them with a powerful thunderstorm! Most of the Druid’s human-form skills last for a duration and aid his animal-form abilities in various ways. As a spellcaster, the Druid can also take advantage of a new Spell Totem skill, which creates a totem that automatically casts any chosen spell for a time. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/15e2c9d29daef9078afa997065ab9eef00d72d1b.png As a creature of the night, the wolf channels the energy of the Moon itself into a flurry of ferocious attacks. Fast and agile, it leaps forward to freeze its foes and rake them with vicious slashes. Being a true alpha, the wolf can also summon a pack of minions to fight alongside it. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/980bac5d291dd93877bfb15ddbfe43404ec1c847.png A hulking powerhouse of strength and brawn, the bear rampages through its enemies, leaving devastation in its wake. By demolishing hordes of monsters, the bear builds up Rage that empowers its attacks and roars, ultimately turning it into a walking calamity. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/28387e600829a9dbc759993c0664014a49934c4a.png A sight seldom seen in Wraeclast, the wyvern leaps into combat and slashes at its enemies with lethal talons. Empowering itself by devouring the freshly dead, the wyvern calls down lightning explosions and spits balls of fire. Of course, it can also take to the skies and rain down streams of flame upon its foes. It is a dragon, after all. This Content Update also introduces two Ascendancy Classes for the Druid. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/3aa4603367f28852d1cef627ef47afbb9efa2382.png The Shaman channels nature’s fury, harnessing Rage to empower his Spells and becoming a walking natural disaster raining down Meteors, Lightning, and Ice. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/702d5d7fcf213290e5502c6e8349915fb85bf0b8.png The Oracle has perfected the power of Foresight, using it in combat to gain a massive advantage by peering into the future to predict a monster's movements and even allocate passives from alternate timelines! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/1312d6ed36882740e7ceb3f77d03b0557ef3f819.png Explore the opulent temple of Atziri, the Queen of the Vaal during the height of her power in the capital of the ancient ...

newsitems.title: What Will Happen When the Rise of the Abyssal League Ends
newsitems.author: kiki
newsitems.contents: With the Last of the Druids Content Update launching next Friday, you may be wondering what will happen to the current Rise of the Abyssal leagues and your existing characters. Your fight with the Abyssals is not over yet, as the mechanic will be added to Path of Exile 2’s core in The Last of the Druids Content Update. We’ll tell you all the details during the livestream on December 4th PST at 11AM. The Rise of the Abyssals league will end on December 8th at 1PM PST. All your characters and their items will be migrated to the Standard or Hardcore Early Access league. There will not be any wipes, so once migration is complete, you can play your characters in the Standard/Hardcore Early Access league. When The Last of the Druids releases on December 12th PST, you will be able to start playing in a new League with a fresh economy. Thanks to everyone for playing in the Rise of the Abyssal! We can’t wait to see you experiencing the upcoming Fate of the Vaal league. See you all on the livestream soon!
